        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConsiderPromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReviewDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinalizePromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Development need or career aspiration identified"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeeds" name="Identify development needs or career aspirations"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePlan" name="Create personal development plan (training, mentorship, or additional responsibilities)"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Split" name="Split: development activities"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SkillEnhancement" name="Continue skill enhancement"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Feedback" name="Receive feedback and evaluation from supervisors"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Feedback" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join"/>
